name: data-fusion-desktop
author: 数据融合助手
description: 本地数据融合桌面工具

scripts.package:win: npm run icons && node scripts/build-windows-update-host.mjs && node scripts/build-export-preserver.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --win --x64
scripts.package:win:dir: npm run icons && node scripts/build-windows-update-host.mjs && node scripts/build-export-preserver.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --win --x64 --dir
scripts.package:linux:x64: npm run icons && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.linux.cjs --linux --x64
scripts.package:linux:arm64: npm run icons && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.linux.cjs --linux --arm64
scripts.test:government-menu: npm run build && esbuild scripts/smoke-government-menu.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --loader:.sql=text --outfile=.tmp/smoke-government-menu.cjs && electron .tmp/smoke-government-menu.cjs
scripts.test:health-tool: npm run build && esbuild scripts/smoke-health-tool.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --loader:.sql=text --outfile=.tmp/smoke-health-tool.cjs && electron .tmp/smoke-health-tool.cjs
scripts.test:source-tabs: npm run build && esbuild scripts/fixtures/source-tabs-preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=.tmp/source-tabs-preload.cjs && esbuild scripts/smoke-source-tabs.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=.tmp/smoke-source-tabs.cjs && electron .tmp/smoke-source-tabs.cjs
scripts.test:ui:desktop: npm run build && esbuild scripts/fixtures/ui-redesign-preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=.tmp/ui-redesign-preload.cjs && esbuild scripts/smoke-ui-redesign.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=.tmp/smoke-ui-redesign.cjs && node scripts/run-ui-smoke.mjs desktop
scripts.test:ui:admin: npm run admin:web:build && esbuild scripts/smoke-admin-ui-redesign.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=.tmp/smoke-admin-ui-redesign.cjs && node scripts/run-ui-smoke.mjs admin
scripts.test:hrss: npm run build && esbuild scripts/fixtures/ui-redesign-preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=.tmp/ui-redesign-preload.cjs && esbuild scripts/smoke-hrss.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=.tmp/smoke-hrss.cjs && node scripts/run-ui-smoke.mjs hrss
scripts.test:ui: npm run test:ui:desktop && npm run test:ui:admin
